items.question: Who becomes the mistress of the elephant army and then the wealth-lady?
premises: She is mistress of elephant army.
items.inference: The verse identifies the goddess as elephant-army mistress then wealth-lady.
uncertainties: Exact mythic referent is not specified in this excerpt.
items.plain_english: She, mistress of the elephant army, thereafter is the wealth-lady.
